title: Someone with a login watches Web Summit's closed channels
summary: Web Summit's X, Instagram and LinkedIn need a login and its attendee app needs a ticket: if the organisers announce there first, a person on the team sees it before any agent. Say who watches them and tells the conductor.
closes: A named person watches those channels, or you say we rely on the public pages only.
blocks: The answers to the open questions (talks, PITCH, side events, tickets) may appear where no agent can read.
